needs_human.note: formatRelativeAge picks a unit by fixed day thresholds: 30-day months below 365 days, then 365-day years. A book added 360 to 364 days ago therefore reads "12 months ago" / "12か月前" instead of "1 year ago". 28 to 29 days reads "4 weeks ago". The tests do not cover any boundary (they check 3, 14, 240 and 730 days only).

No invariant or revision names this for Video.; A ReadingCard without a thumbnail now prints the title inside the cover instead of a file-type icon. I29 does not cover this.; The Tag menu's empty value text changes from 'Tag' to 'None specified'.
